  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "1588b45f6147eb4d77b5c19cf3280e540073fec5858fce3fd13575659c8a1115",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"For every real a, b and s, the spatial state function at s is interval integrable from a to b, and its interval integral, considered as a function of time, has derivative flux(q(a,s)) minus flux(q(b,s)) at s.","effect_on_target":"Assumes the integral conservation law and spatial interval integrability at every real time, not merely at the selected time t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"The one-by-one real matrix whose only entry is speed.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the coefficient matrix to a constant scalar speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"Maps a state vector to its product with the coefficient matrix, with components (A v)_i = sum_j A_ij v_j.","effect_on_target":"Defines the flux; for the supplied one-by-one matrix it multiplies the only state component by speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"The scalar specialization of LocalDef007: two partial derivatives exist at (x,t) and their time derivative plus speed times spatial derivative is zero.","effect_on_target":"Expands the second conclusion into existential scalar derivative witnesses and their equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"LocalDef005","meaning":"Embeds q(x,t) as the function on Fin 1 having value q(x,t) at its sole index.","effect_on_target":"All state and derivative hypotheses use one-component real vectors representing a scalar field.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"LocalDef006","meaning":"Real scalar multiplication on the space of real-valued functions on any index type is jointly continuous in the product topology.","effect_on_target":"Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication for vector-valued differentiation; it adds no assumption on q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"LocalDef007","meaning":"For a field q taking values in a real normed vector space E, there exist u and v in E such that the time derivative at (x,t) is u, the spatial derivative there is v, and u + speed • v = 0.","effect_on_target":"At E = Real, the conclusion asserts existence of scalar partial derivatives satisfying u + speed v = 0 at each x.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"LocalDef008","meaning":"Scalar multiplication is jointly continuous in every real normed vector space.","effect_on_target":"Supports differentiation in LocalDef007 without an additional regularity hypothesis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Forgets commutativity from an additive commutative monoid while retaining its operations.","effect_on_target":"Provides the additive monoid underlying the scalar module structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"Algebra.id","meaning":"The algebra of a commutative semiring over itself, with identity algebra map and scalar multiplication given by multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Real scalar multiplication on Real is ordinary real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"Algebra.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.","effect_on_target":"Selects real multiplication in the self-algebra used for continuity of scalar multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction requiring both propositions.","effect_on_target":"Both final conclusions hold; integrability and derivative assertions in the conservation law, and all clauses of the derivative-witness conclusion, are simultaneous requirements.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"Continuous","meaning":"Continuity of a function for its specified domain and codomain topologies.","effect_on_target":"Requires x ↦ qt(x) + fluxx(x) to be continuous on all of Real in the product topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField","meaning":"Obtains a nontrivially normed field from a densely normed field, preserving its normed field structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar field structure needed for derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"DistribMulAction.toMulAction","meaning":"Forgets distributivity from a distributive monoid action, preserving the action.","effect_on_target":"Retains the same scalar multiplication in the module-to-action instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"DivisionSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the semiring structure from a division semiring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies ordinary real addition and multiplication for modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of two objects of the same type.","effect_on_target":"The flux identity is equality of functions, hence componentwise equality, and the differential equation is exact equality to zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"Field.toSemifield","meaning":"Retains a field's semiring, inversion and division structure as a semifield.","effect_on_target":"Provides inherited real scalar structures without imposing any restriction on speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"Fin","meaning":"Fin n is the type of natural indices strictly less than n.","effect_on_target":"Fin 1 contains exactly the index 0, so the state space has one real component.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"Fin.fintype","meaning":"Enumerates all indices of Fin n.","effect_on_target":"Makes matrix sums and finite product norm structures available; the relevant sum has one term.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"Fin.instOfNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural numeral in Fin n, for nonzero n, by reduction modulo n.","effect_on_target":"The numeral 0 in state 0 denotes the unique index of Fin 1.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"Extracts the addition operation from its supplied addition instance.","effect_on_target":"Adds derivative vectors componentwise and scalar derivatives by real addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"HMul.hMul","meaning":"Extracts the multiplication operation from its supplied multiplication instance.","effect_on_target":"The product speed times state 0 is ordinary real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"HasDerivAt","meaning":"A function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the full neighborhood filter at that point and a fixed base point.","effect_on_target":"All derivatives are ordinary two-sided derivatives on Real, with the stated scalar or one-component vector values; they are not merely formal derivative symbols.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","meaning":"Extracts the compatible normed vector space structure from an inner product space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the usual real normed vector space used for derivatives and integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"IntervalIntegrable","meaning":"The function is integrable on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the specified measure.","effect_on_target":"Requires integrability over the interval between either ordering of the endpoints; equal endpoints impose only empty-interval integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul","meaning":"A module topology guarantees jointly continuous scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Supplies continuity of the standard scalar action for differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring","meaning":"A topological ring has continuous semiring operations.","effect_on_target":"Supports continuity of real multiplication in the scalar-action construction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology","meaning":"A topological semiring has the module topology for its action on itself.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real self-module topology used to establish continuous scalar multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","meaning":"Extracts the designated measure from a measure-space instance.","effect_on_target":"Every integral and integrability hypothesis uses the measure supplied by Real.measureSpace.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"Module.toDistribMulAction","meaning":"Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real scalar action underlying vector derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"Monoid.toSemigroup","meaning":"Forgets the identity axiom and data from a monoid while preserving multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Supports the scalar-action instance chain without changing real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"MonoidWithZero.toMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the multiplicative real monoid for scalar actions, including action by zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"MulAction.toSemigroupAction","meaning":"Extracts the semigroup action underlying a monoid action.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the same real scalar multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"Nat","meaning":"The natural numbers, including zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the dimension 1 and index numeral 0; there is no natural-number parameter in the proposition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"Nat.instNeZeroSucc","meaning":"Every natural successor n + 1 is nonzero.","effect_on_target":"Justifies interpreting 0 as an element of Fin 1; it does not assert speed is nonzero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the requirement of associative multiplication while retaining the commutative ring operations without a unit.","effect_on_target":"Provides a weaker view of Real's ring structure for topological instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a nonunital nonassociative commutative ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the ring structure used in continuity instances, with unchanged operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid from the semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real addition and zero for the vector module structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the norm from a nonunital normed commutative ring.","effect_on_target":"Retains ordinary real ring operations in the topology instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real seminorm and operations used to construct the normed space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the additive group, norm and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real additive seminormed structure used in vector calculus.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Forgets associativity as a required property of a nonunital semiring, preserving its operations.","effect_on_target":"Provides the additive structure underlying the real module without changing arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField","meaning":"Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the standard real norm and field operations for differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup","meaning":"Forgets commutativity from a normed additive commutative group while preserving norm, metric and addition.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the normed additive group used to define interval integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Regards a normed additive group as an additive monoid with its norm valued in the extended nonnegative reals.","effect_on_target":"Provides the norm used in integrability of qt and fluxx.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the designated multiplicative unit from a normed commutative ring, retaining norm and operations.","effect_on_target":"Supports real topological ring instances without altering the topology or arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Regards a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same norm and induced pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Preserves standard real analytic structures in the derivative and integral instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"NormedField.toField","meaning":"Extracts the field structure from a normed field.","effect_on_target":"Supplies ordinary real field operations for scalar modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"NormedField.toNormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains the commutative ring, norm and metric of a normed field.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the usual real normed ring structure behind the topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","meaning":"Extracts the scalar module from a normed vector space.","effect_on_target":"Determines real scalar multiplication in the derivative structures and equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Extracts the value assigned to a natural numeral by its instance.","effect_on_target":"Interprets the dimension 1, the sole index 0 and additive zero in their respective types.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"Pi.Function.module","meaning":"Equips a function space with the pointwise module structure inherited from its codomain.","effect_on_target":"The one-component vectors have pointwise real addition and scalar multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"Pi.addCommGroup","meaning":"Equips a family of functions with pointwise additive commutative group operations.","effect_on_target":"Vector derivatives and flux differences use componentwise group operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"Pi.instAdd","meaning":"Defines (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).","effect_on_target":"The continuous residual has sole component qt(x)(0) + fluxx(x)(0).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"Pi.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Equips a finite product of normed additive commutative groups with its product normed additive commutative group structure.","effect_on_target":"Makes the one-component state space a normed additive commutative group suitable for integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Pi.normedAddGroup","meaning":"Equips a finite product of normed additive groups with its product normed additive group structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides the normed space of one-component derivative values for integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Pi.normedSpace","meaning":"Equips a finite product of normed vector spaces with the pointwise module and compatible product norm.","effect_on_target":"Allows real vector-valued interval integration in the state space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Pi.topologicalSpace","meaning":"The product topology, obtained as the infimum of topologies induced by coordinate evaluations.","effect_on_target":"Continuity and convergence of the one-component functions are equivalent to those of their sole real coordinate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","meaning":"Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.","effect_on_target":"Carries the usual real metric structure into the topology used for derivatives and continuity.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","meaning":"Regards a real-or-complex-like field as a real inner product space with its compatible real normed space structure.","effect_on_target":"At Real, supplies the usual real vector space and norm; it introduces no complex-valued variables.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"Real","meaning":"The real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Space, time, speed, field values and scalar derivative witnesses are real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Real.denselyNormedField","meaning":"The real normed field has norm values between any two strictly ordered nonnegative bounds.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the nontrivial normed scalar field needed for ordinary real differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Real.instAdd","meaning":"Ordinary real addition.","effect_on_target":"Determines scalar sums and the coordinatewise vector residual.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"The additive commutative group structure of Real.","effect_on_target":"Provides addition, subtraction, negation and zero for derivative values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","meaning":"The commutative semiring structure of Real.","effect_on_target":"Supports the identity real algebra with ordinary multiplication as its scalar action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"Real.instMul","meaning":"Ordinary real multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Defines speed times the state component in the first conclusion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"Real.instRCLike","meaning":"Real as an RCLike field, with identity real part, zero imaginary part, completeness and its usual normed real algebra structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides standard real normed vector structures; the target remains entirely real-valued.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"Real.instRing","meaning":"The ring structure of Real.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the ordinary real arithmetic underlying the module instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"Real.measureSpace","meaning":"The standard measure-space instance on Real, whose volume is real Lebesgue measure.","effect_on_target":"All stated integrals and integrability conditions are with respect to Lebesgue measure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"The real additive commutative group with its usual norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Gives scalar and coordinate values their ordinary analytic norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"Real.normedCommRing","meaning":"The usual real commutative ring with its compatible norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Supplies standard norm and topology for the real operations used throughout.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"Real.normedField","meaning":"The usual real field with its absolute-value norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Sets the scalar analytic structure for every derivative and integral.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"The real distance is d(x,y) = |x - y|, with its associated uniform structure.","effect_on_target":"Derivatives and continuity use the usual topology on Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"Real.semiring","meaning":"The real semiring with ordinary addition and multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Supports real self-algebra and module topology instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"Ring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the semiring structure from a ring.","effect_on_target":"Retains ordinary real addition and multiplication for module construction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"Semifield.toDivisionSemiring","meaning":"Retains the division semiring structure of a semifield.","effect_on_target":"Supplies inherited real scalar arithmetic without adding a nonzero-speed condition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"SemigroupAction.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar action operation from a semigroup action.","effect_on_target":"Selects the scalar multiplication used in the derivative module topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the unit from a seminormed commutative ring while preserving norm, pseudometric and operations.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real seminormed additive structure used in normed vector spaces.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a seminormed commutative ring.","effect_on_target":"Provides the same real seminorm and topology in the instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Extracts the pseudometric structure of a seminormed ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real topology for continuous scalar multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"Semiring.toMonoidWithZero","meaning":"Retains multiplication, one and zero from a semiring, with their monoid-with-zero laws.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar multiplicative structure, allowing zero as a scalar.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring","meaning":"Forgets the designated unit from a semiring while retaining addition and multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the additive structure required by real module instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","meaning":"Extracts the topology of a uniform space.","effect_on_target":"Uses the topology associated with the ordinary real metric for analytic assertions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"instContinuousSMulForall","meaning":"Coordinatewise continuous scalar actions induce jointly continuous scalar multiplication on the product function space.","effect_on_target":"Justifies differentiation of functions valued in Fin 1 → Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Uses a same-type addition operation as heterogeneous addition with the same input and output type.","effect_on_target":"Resolves addition notation to the stated real or pointwise vector addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"instHMul","meaning":"Uses a same-type multiplication operation as heterogeneous multiplication with the same input and output type.","effect_on_target":"Resolves the first conclusion's multiplication to real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"instIsTopologicalRingReal","meaning":"Real is a topological ring: its ring operations are continuous.","effect_on_target":"Provides the standard continuity facts for constructing continuous real scalar actions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"instOfNatNat","meaning":"A numeral interpreted in Nat has its specified natural-number value.","effect_on_target":"The dimension is exactly 1 and the underlying index numeral is exactly 0.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"intervalIntegral","meaning":"The oriented interval integral is the Bochner integral on (a,b] minus the Bochner integral on (b,a].","effect_on_target":"Integrals reverse sign when endpoints are reversed and vanish for equal endpoints; their values are one-component real vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"Fintype","meaning":"A finite type equipped with an exhaustive finite enumeration.","effect_on_target":"Allows finite matrix-vector sums and finite product analytic structures; the target uses the nonempty singleton Fin 1.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"HSub.hSub","meaning":"Extracts subtraction from its supplied instance.","effect_on_target":"Forms left boundary flux minus right boundary flux and the difference of the two oriented integral terms.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"Matrix","meaning":"A matrix with row type m, column type n and entries in α is a function m → n → α.","effect_on_target":"The coefficient is concretely a one-by-one array of real entries.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"Matrix.mulVec","meaning":"The component at row i is the dot product of row i with the vector, namely sum_j M(i,j)v(j).","effect_on_target":"For Fin 1 and constant entry speed, the flux's only component is speed times state(0).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Retains the additive monoid and distributive multiplication from the ring structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real arithmetic needed for matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"NormedField.toNormedSpace","meaning":"A normed field is a normed vector space over itself with multiplication as scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"The scalar specialization of the concluding equation uses ordinary real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"Pi.instSub","meaning":"Defines (f - g)(i) = f(i) - g(i).","effect_on_target":"The boundary flux difference in the conservation law is componentwise subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"Real.instSub","meaning":"Real subtraction is addition of the additive negative.","effect_on_target":"The conservation law has the sign speed q(a,s) minus speed q(b,s).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"instHSub","meaning":"Uses a subtraction operation as heterogeneous subtraction with the same input and output type.","effect_on_target":"Resolves subtraction to real or pointwise vector subtraction as appropriate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid","meaning":"An additive commutative group supplies a commutative subtraction monoid with its existing negation and subtraction.","effect_on_target":"Supports the additive zero and negation structures in the normed-space differential equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"AddCommMagma.toAdd","meaning":"Extracts addition from an additive commutative magma.","effect_on_target":"Provides the unchanged addition used in the residual equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup","meaning":"Forgets zero from an additive commutative monoid while retaining associative commutative addition.","effect_on_target":"Supports the addition instance for derivative witnesses.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma","meaning":"Retains commutative addition while forgetting associativity as a required property.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the addition operation in the concluding equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass","meaning":"Retains addition, zero and the additive identity laws from an additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides the zero used in the scalar differential equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"AddZero.toZero","meaning":"Extracts zero from an addition-with-zero structure.","effect_on_target":"Selects the additive zero on the right side of the concluding equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"AddZeroClass.toAddZero","meaning":"Extracts addition and zero from a structure asserting the additive identity laws.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the same zero in the normed-space equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"ContinuousSMul","meaning":"Joint continuity of the scalar multiplication map (c,v) ↦ c • v.","effect_on_target":"Ensures scalar actions are compatible with the topology used in derivative assertions; supplied instances establish it automatically.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul","meaning":"Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive action.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the same linear scalar action used in LocalDef007.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass","meaning":"Retains scalar multiplication and the law that scalar multiplication preserves zero.","effect_on_target":"Supports the scalar-action instance of the differential equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Regards an extended-normed additive commutative monoid as extended-seminormed, preserving its structure.","effect_on_target":"Supports the additive structures inherited from the normed codomain in LocalDef007.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Preserves addition and zero for the derivative-witness equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D112","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Forgets commutativity from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides an inherited additive structure without changing the equation's operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D113","name":"ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid from an extended-seminormed additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition and zero in the normed-space instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D114","name":"Exists","meaning":"Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.","effect_on_target":"For each real x there exist scalar time and spatial derivative values; the witnesses may depend on x and the fixed input data.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D115","name":"HSMul.hSMul","meaning":"Extracts scalar multiplication from its supplied instance.","effect_on_target":"The concluding term speed • v is ordinary speed times v in Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D116","name":"NegZeroClass.toZero","meaning":"Extracts zero from a structure with negation preserving zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the same additive zero on the right side of LocalDef007's equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D117","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive commutative group with a norm and compatible metric d(x,y) = ||x - y||.","effect_on_target":"Specifies the ambient analytic additive structure for LocalDef007, instantiated here by Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D118","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative group from a normed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the addition and group operations used by derivatives and the concluding equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D119","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Regards a normed additive commutative group as an extended-normed additive commutative monoid using the same norm.","effect_on_target":"Supplies inherited additive and zero structures for the normed-space predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D120","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive group and induced pseudometric while forgetting norm separation as a required property.","effect_on_target":"Provides the seminormed structure required by the real normed-space instance.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D121","name":"NormedSpace","meaning":"A scalar module over a normed field whose scalar multiplication is compatible with the norms.","effect_on_target":"LocalDef007 is defined in a real normed vector space, specialized in this target to Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D122","name":"Pi.instSMul","meaning":"Defines scalar multiplication of functions pointwise: (c • f)(i) = c • f(i).","effect_on_target":"The real scalar action on the one-component state space is coordinatewise multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D123","name":"Real.instMonoid","meaning":"The multiplicative monoid structure of Real.","effect_on_target":"Supports scalar actions by arbitrary real numbers, including zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D124","name":"SMulZeroClass.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts scalar multiplication from an action preserving zero.","effect_on_target":"Selects the unchanged scalar multiplication in the differential equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D125","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Extracts the pseudometric associated with the seminormed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the topology used by the derivative predicates in LocalDef007.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D126","name":"SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass","meaning":"Retains zero and negation, including the law that negation fixes zero.","effect_on_target":"Supports the additive zero used in LocalDef007.","status":"understood"},

      "Fin 1 is the singleton index set {0}; V consists of functions on this singleton and is naturally identified with Real by evaluation at 0.",

    "proposition_plain_english": "For every real scalar field q(x,s), constant real speed, selected real time t, and three supplied one-component derivative fields qt, qx and fluxx, assume the following. At every real time s and for every pair of spatial endpoints, the field is interval integrable and the time derivative of its spatial integral equals the left boundary flux minus the right boundary flux, where the flux is multiplication by the one-by-one matrix with entry speed. At the selected time t, qt and qx are respectively the time and spatial derivatives of the embedded field, and fluxx is the spatial derivative of its flux, at every position. The fields qt and fluxx are integrable on every bounded interval; differentiation of every spatial interval integral at t gives the interval integral of qt; and qt + fluxx is continuous in space. Then both of the following hold: the matrix flux sends every one-component state to speed times its sole component, and at every real position x there exist scalar time and spatial derivatives of q at (x,t) whose values u and v satisfy u + speed v = 0."
